research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Hex Technologies is researching a real-time multi user collaboration system for authenticated data connections in a notebook environment of executable cells that retrieve data from a data warehouse. They develop priming generative AI model leveraging directed acyclic graph driven notebook structures, along with optimized execution and parallel execution of cells and dynamic data warehouse computational offloading in a directed acyclic graph environment. Together these efforts target collaborative, AI assisted, and performance optimized analytics notebooks.

overview_description.description: Hex Technologies provides a collaborative data workspace that integrates SQL, Python, R, and no-code tools within a unified notebook interface. This platform enables users to conduct data analysis, build interactive applications, and share insights seamlessly. Features include real-time collaboration, AI-assisted code generation, and visualization tools designed to streamline workflows for both technical and non-technical team members. Hex offers integrations with modern data stacks such as Snowflake and dbt, facilitating smooth incorporation into existing infrastructures. The platform supports various deployment models, including multi-tenant and private cloud options, to meet diverse organizational needs. Hex serves a broad range of industries, providing tools that enhance data-driven decision-making processes.
